entities.summary: Noel Pearson is an Aboriginal Australian lawyer, academic, and advocate for Indigenous empowerment. He is known for his work on land rights, welfare reform, and education policy, and for founding organisations such as the Cape York Land Council, Cape York Institute for Policy and Leadership, Cape York Partnership, and Good to Great Schools Australia.
